verdict.rationale: PostHog AI is documented as an assistant that lives inside PostHog, in a chat sidebar and inline entry points. It queries data, writes SQL, and finds replays, and it also does the work: it creates dashboards, surveys, alerts and feature flags, edits UI filters, remembers context between conversations, and can start coding tasks that end in PRs. The same agent also powers Slack and Desktop, and PostHog AI can write Hog functions for you. One hands-on user report confirms the in-product assistant exists but found it could not create a SQL-based cohort and slowed the UI badly after two prompts; that is a limitation, not a contradiction of the documented task set. Missing for 10: positive independent corroboration of delegated task completion, and evidence on the assistant's task coverage and responsiveness (cohort creation, UI performance).
